name: Asymmetric Constraint Disguise
description: Rephrased the symmetric inequality (not equal) as an asymmetric condition ("one must be strictly higher than the other") to prevent the model from mapping the problem to standard graph coloring. This forces the model to logically deduce that requiring one value to be strictly higher than the other for an unordered pair is perfectly equivalent to requiring them to be different, bypassing surface-level template matching.
